actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: President Trump is dominating headlines with a series of high-profile executive actions, including hosting tech leaders at the White House to establish voluntary AI self-regulation safeguards and securing a favorable Supreme Court ruling to resume third-country deportations. His administration is also driving economic and regulatory shifts through new trade restrictions on Canadian imports, fuel efficiency standard rollbacks, and active midterm campaign rallies.

actors.name: Sylvi Listhaug
actors.blurb: Progress Party leader Sylvi Listhaug is generating major political headlines in Norway by fiercely condemning record fuel prices and demanding the immediate reintroduction of fuel tax cuts. Her aggressive stance has sparked public clashes with center-right rival Høyre, while her party enjoys significant gains in regional polling at the expense of the governing Labour Party.

actors.name: Michelle Wu
actors.blurb: Boston Mayor Michelle Wu has filed a major lawsuit against the Trump administration following the federal government's decision to claw back a $20 million federal transit grant designated for Roxbury neighborhood improvements. Wu contends the funding revocation is unlawful and politically motivated, positioning her at the forefront of local opposition to federal spending rollbacks.
